name: 2100-APPLY-TXN
description: This paragraph applies a transaction to the current processing context, potentially involving updates and I/O operations.

algorithm.details: Copies values to working storage for transaction processing.
Invokes a routine to handle part of the transaction application logic.
Logs or records transaction details to an output file.
Updates computed values, such as totals or balances.

sideEffects.description: Logs the outcome of the transaction processing.
